Resolves #19279

A popped-out pane's dock host fits its popup window again. #18383 (09-06) retired the viewport-level vessel target, and with it `app.mainView.addCls('workstation-vessel-target')`. The rule that gave `.workstation-vessel-dock-host` its `min-height: 0` was keyed on `.workstation-popout-host.workstation-vessel-target`, so it went dead with the class. In a popup, the host is a flex child of a column viewport sized to the window. With its automatic minimum it grew to its content: a 1,885 px host in a 240 px window, and a 1,800 px grid view that never overflowed. So a popped-out grid could neither scroll nor virtualize, and the hover-sync addon never loaded (`WorkstationPopOutHoverSyncNL`'s census red).

The rule now keys on `.workstation-popout-host`, which `ViewportController` still applies, and keeps only the constraint (`min-height` / `min-width: 0`) and the host's `position`. The dead block's other declarations stay retired:
- its `.neo-dock-preview` positioning is the engine sheet's own (`dashboard/dock/interaction/Preview.scss`);
- the viewport already paints the ground colour;
- its `padding` has not applied since 09-06, so the popup keeps the look #19251 aligned the provisional chrome to.

Evidence: L2 (real headless popups: the spec red at dev and green here, the ancestor-chain measurement, a batch of the Workstation popup specs) → L2 required. Residual: none of this ticket's.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Measured in the popup (innerHeight 240), walking the ancestor chain: the viewport is 240 px, its `.workstation-vessel-dock-host` 1,885 px with `min-height: auto`. With the fix, the spec's new assertion "the popped-out grid view fits its window, so a wheel can scroll it" passes, and the wheel scrolls the view. |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: `WorkstationPopOutHoverSyncNL` 1 passed at the head, dev themes rebuilt (the compiled rule asserted in `Viewport.css`). Red-first: bisected, 1 passed at `3a0773c9a5^`, 1 failed from `3a0773c9a5` (#18383). |
| AC-3 | The spec's fit assertion pins the constraint and names it when it breaks. |

None. The ticket's unmeasured link is the vessel dock host.
